verdict.rationale: A secure client portal or extranet is a fair axis for a law firm, but the evidence never documents one for matters, documents, or status. LathamDrive is described as an entrepreneur resource hub with a document generator, glossary and FAQs. That is an adjacent tool, not a secure matter portal.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages
